notablePrerequisites: You have a land card in your hand.
description:
Cast Scouting Trek by paying {1}{G}, searching your library for any number of basic land cards and putting them on top of your library.
Cast Cultivator Colossus by paying {4}{G}{G}{G}.
When Cultivator Colossus enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to put a land card from your hand onto the battlefield, and then draw a card.
The process in step 3 repeats until you are unable to put a land onto the battlefield.
